note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Exploded join of a fictional supply agreement: clause 2 lifts out of the contract, Annex 1 rises out of its folder; the tracer runs folder → annex → clause → contract and the reference is written when it reaches the clause.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a lease whose clause 3 is linked to an inventory annex; the pen and the seal are the focus of a different traversal (pen → clause → annex → seal), the folder relation is shown as a communication and the seal relation is omitted from the contract side.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long element labels, relation captions, clause heading and reference to exercise wrapping and label placement.
